name: a re-attempt of a step on a different tool version is marked as drift
description: Step 1 already has a completed attempt on fastp 0.23.4. A second attempt on the same step ran 0.24.0. When the new attempt's enrichment completes, the block must carry drift: [{tool_id, from, to}] -- versions only, compared on the tool id without its version segment -- and a drift.detected row must name the attempt it was compared against.
